shortDescription: India's Ujjivan Small Finance Bank NSE:UJJIVANSFB said on Tuesday that CEO Sanjeev Nautiyal has stepped down from his role with immediate effect due to health issues and would retire from the bank at the end of November.The Reserve Bank of India approved the appointment of Executive Director Carol…

children: said on Tuesday that CEO Sanjeev Nautiyal has stepped down from his role with immediate effect due to health issues and would retire from the bank at the end of November.
The Reserve Bank of India approved the appointment of Executive Director Carol Furtado as interim CEO from September 1, the company said late Tuesday.
Ujjivan said Nautiyal, who served as CEO since July 2024, had submitted his request for early retirement on August 31 with a three-month notice period, which was approved by the bank's board.
Nautiyal will remain on leave until November 30, when he will retire from the bank.
The board will begin the process of identifying a permanent successor and submit its recommendation to RBI in due course, it said.
Ujjivan has been seeking to transition from a small finance bank to a universal lender, a move that would allow it to operate with a broader banking mandate.
The RBI returned Ujjivan's universal bank application in April and asked it to reapply after further diversifying its loan portfolio.
